name: Amazon PAAPI5
description: Integrates the Amazon Product Advertising API (v5 / Creators API) to fetch, cache and display product data, prices, images and affiliate links.
library_dependencies: Amazon Creators/PA-API PHP SDK (installed manually to /libraries/creatorsapi-php-sdk, see INSTALL.txt)
project_description: Amazon PAAPI5 is a Drupal wrapper and caching layer around the Amazon Product Advertising API (branch 3.x targets Amazon's newer Creators API). Given an ASIN it fetches product data (title, brand, prices, savings, images, contributors, sales rank) through Amazon's official PHP SDK, cleans it into a set of local tables and exposes it for display. The base module provides the admin settings, credential storage, cron-based refresh and the theming/templating layer; the bundled submodules add the [amazon:ASIN:selector] text filter (amazon_pa_filter) and an ASIN field type with field formatters and Views integration (asin). The Amazon SDK is not shipped and must be installed manually into /libraries as described in INSTALL.txt.
